descriptive_pattern_metrics.scope: Occupied8mm/4.8mm source sample andwhole-part palette projectedonto the same normalizedbody. Excludes studs,gaps,chamfers andsupports; realCGmustbeviewed separately.

front.interpretation: Descriptive projected geometry overlap/boundary distance; no aesthetic or mechanical pass threshold

side.interpretation: Descriptive projected geometry overlap/boundary distance; no aesthetic or mechanical pass threshold

painted_feature_region.interpretation: Nearest source palette labels on actual registered visible surfaces. Face pose, color regions and gaps influence this statistic; it does not declare likeness approval.

descriptive_pattern_metrics.region_definition: Tight reference-front bbox of all non-base colorcells plus5pixels; not automatic anatomical landmark detection.
descriptive_pattern_metrics.interpretation: Differences are descriptive. Morepieces are not a validated likeness percentage or mechanical completion.

front.framing_method: Actual native vertex projection, not empty bounding-box corners; center and screen-height normalization per model.
front.normalization_note: The four shapes occupy equal screen height; this image group is NOT a physical size comparison.

three_quarter.framing_method: Actual native vertex projection, not empty bounding-box corners; center and screen-height normalization per model.
three_quarter.normalization_note: The four shapes occupy equal screen height; this image group is NOT a physical size comparison.

limitations_ja: 倍率は実部品数で、寸法倍率ではありません。比較1xは本人不在時の暫定前提です。
完成サイズ増加で元形状の相対格子解像度を上げていますが、色境界は初期C参照で、美観改善の保証ではありません。
放射状分解は説明図。物理的に衝突せず分解できる保証ではありません。下からの順序は公称支持の検査で、保持力は未確認です。
limitations_en: The multiplier is actual physicalpiececount, not linearsize. The1xbaseline is a provisional creator assumption while the user was unavailable.
Larger fixed-pitch sampling increases relative contour resolution; colors reference initialC. More parts do not guarantee better appearance.
Radial explosion is explanatory, not collision-free physical disassembly. Bottom-up order has nominal support checks, not verified retention.

observations_ja: 実19,309部品、固定分母9,669・目標19,338との差-29で許容内。完成正面・斜めと実MP4 frame1/18/54/73/108/144を閲覧した。
実寸375.8x551.8x473.8mm、実部品数倍率1.997001。黄色の頭・胴、黒い目、橙色のくちばし、翼と尾を実ブロックで表している。頭頂や胸の段階、目と嘴の角張りが残り、数量増加を外観合格とはしない。
重要な条件差として、本体19,309部品・106型とは別に実3個の仮支持台が必要。この案は支台なしではない。正面や斜めでは嘴の下に支台が見え、隣接する3個が一本の柱のように重なって見えるが、1個へ数え直したり隠したりしない。
aid-01はstep8257のDUCKY-P200-008384、aid-02はstep8258のDUCKY-P200-008400、aid-03はstep8538のDUCKY-P200-008711を支持する。支持高さは193.6/193.6/198.4mmで、それぞれの部品を置く前に必要。ID末尾を組立stepと誤認しない。
frame73は本体0部品だが、別管理の支台は準備物として残る。元データのremoval_gateに従い、現物の保持力と安定性を確認する前に撤去しない。撤去動作自体も未検証であり、完成CGだけから支台を消して自立を装わない。
1x1例外9個、長辺15.8mm以上19,300個。native保存・別展開再openの全ID/type/color/pose/step、保存sceneの106型の実頂点・面、分解からの絶対位置復帰、本体0から全19,309部品への動作が一致した。
本成果は未選択のデジタル比較案。支台の座屈・接地・撤去、PLAの保持力、嵌合、荷重、転倒は未検証であり、スライスや印刷の承認ではない。Mona限定の支台なし条件を満たす案として扱わない。
observations_en: Actual19,309 pieces against the fixed9,669 denominator and target19,338, difference-29 within tolerance. Front/three-quarter stills and actual MP4 frames1/18/54/73/108/144 were inspected.

Actual size375.8x551.8x473.8mm and piece-count ratio1.997001. Yellow head/body, black eyes, orange beak, wings and tail are actual bricks. Crown/chest terraces and angular eye/beak boundaries remain; higher count is not appearance approval.

This case has a material condition difference: three actual temporary supports are separate from the19,309figure pieces/106types. It is not stand-free. The three adjacent supports overlap visually like one pillar beneath the beak, but are neither recounted as one nor hidden.

Aid01 supports DUCKY-P200-008384 at step8257, aid02 supports DUCKY-P200-008400 at step8258, and aid03 supports DUCKY-P200-008711 at step8538. Their support Z values are193.6/193.6/198.4mm. Each is needed before its supported part; ID suffixes are not assembly-step numbers.

Frame73has zero figure pieces while separate preparation aids remain visible. The source removal gate forbids removal before physical retention and stability checks. Withdrawal is unvalidated; aids are not erased from assembled CG to imply unsupported stability.

There are9one-cell exceptions and19,300parts with a long side of at least15.8mm. Native saving and relocation match all IDs/types/colors/poses/steps. The saved scene matches106native mesh types, absolute radial return and zero-to-all19,309figure instances.

This unselected digital comparison does not validate support buckling, ground contact, withdrawal, PLA retention, fit, loading or tipping, and does not approve slicing or printing. It is not presented as satisfying the Mona-specific no-stand requirement.
